name: backup a folder
script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SOURCE_DIR="<source_dir>"
BACKUP_DIR="<backup_dir>"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
tar -czf "$BACKUP_DIR/backup-$STAMP.tar.gz" -C "$SOURCE_DIR" .
echo "Backup created: $BACKUP_DIR/backup-$STAMP.tar.gz"
explanation: Creates timestamped tar.gz backups for a source directory.
safety: Review SOURCE_DIR and BACKUP_DIR before running to avoid writing in wrong locations.

name: loop through files
script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

for file in <dir>/*; do
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue
  echo "Processing: $file"
done
explanation: Loops through regular files in a directory safely.

name: rename files by extension
script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

for file in <dir>/*.txt; do
  [ -e "$file" ] || continue
  mv -- "$file" "${file%.txt}.md"
done
explanation: Renames .txt files to .md using parameter expansion.
safety: Test first with echo mv ... to preview rename operations.

name: check if file exists in a script
script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TARGET="<file>"
if [ -f "$TARGET" ]; then
  echo "Found: $TARGET"
else
  echo "Missing: $TARGET"
fi
explanation: Checks whether a file exists and prints a clear status.

placeholders.<file>: Path to the file to check.
